## The Spice of Remembering

Tihana traced the chipped ceramic of her teacup, the steam barely warming her hands. The cafe, “Saffron & Stone,” was a haven, smelling of cardamom and old books. But today, even the comforting scent felt… muted. It had been six months since Karimah had left for Morocco, six months since the vibrant pulse of their shared life had quieted.
